basic_info.description: Welcome to this versatile single family with permitted lower unit in the vibrant Outer Mission. This well maintained home offers flexible living and an unbeatable location. 2bd/1ba up and 1bd/1ba permitted lower level unit with separate entrance for privacy. Main level features an ornate corner fireplace in living room with hardwood floors throughout, 2 spacious bedrooms and bath with separate shower. The bright kitchen has ample work space and cabinets; there is also a small deck area off the dining room.  On the lower level you will find a family area, 1 bedroom with shower plus a bonus room which is perfect for an office, guests, or storage. Entry to the backyard is also on this level. There is plenty of natural light and ample storage space throughout this home.  Extra large 3 tiered backyard space with patio is ready for you to create your own urban oasis...  Near Daly City BART & 280 Freeway. Easy commute to downtown SF and the Peninsula. Convenient shopping distance to H-Mart, Jagalichi Market, and Westlake Shopping Center. With a walk Score 81 & Transit Score 82, this home is perfect for extended families or rental income.
